mapper.select: SELECT m.menu_no AS menuNo , m.menu_name AS menuName , m.parent_no AS parentNo , m.menu_lev AS menuLev , m.sort_ord AS sortOrd , TRIM(LEADING '/' FROM p.pro_path) AS proPath FROM menu m LEFT JOIN program p ON m.pro_no = p.pro_no AND p.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE m.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.menu_lev = 0 THEN m.menu_no ELSE m.parent_no END , m.menu_lev , m.sort_ord
